info.description: Get /auth/session first. Send its csrf as X-CSRF-Token on mutations. Signed cookie sessions; one API instance. Collections use page/limit (1/20; max 100).

matched.description: Scores are assigned by template position: left is home, right is away. No team-name matching is performed.

stats.description: All thirteen match stat rows when tournament stat recording is enabled; empty array when disabled. Unreadable cells are null. Suggestions only.
